clips.title: The story
paras: Pilot Bellowfiz needs Evershine from Brewnall Village for his siege engine at Steelgrill's Depot. Brewer Rejold Barleybrew will part with a cask only after the predators near the village are driven off.

Rejold Barleybrew has the cask of Evershine Pilot Bellowfiz needs, but he will not give away his prized brew. Instead of asking for coin, Rejold asks you to thin the wild beasts of western Dun Morogh. Ice Claw Bears, Elder Crag Boars, and Snow Leopards roam close to Brewnall Village, bringing danger to the locals.

Rejold insists that no self-respecting dwarf cowers before wild animals. Still, dealing with predators around the village takes valuable hours. With the beasts thinned, the villagers can focus on distilling and smithing without keeping watch on the tree line.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I have a cask of Evershine handy, but...can you do me a favor? Brewnall village could use a hand against the wild animals that wander the nearby snows. Sometimes they wander close.
We're not afraid of these bears and cats and boars - no self respecting traveler would be - but if you can take care of those animals for us, then we'd have more time for our crafting and brewing.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you taken care of those wild animals?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, friend. It'll be nice to work our crafts without hearing so many growls and snorts outside the village.
